args.title: Saltmarsh: Retail Returns Logistics (combined summary)
args.body:
- Return rates for apparel reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by about a fifth (~20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days kept most of the margin (companion piece).

Sources: https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns ; https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion
